description: Creates a DRAFT dossier, whose certificate (a PDF) covers the evidences you link to it. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId. Generate a UUID v4 for `id`: the API returns no body, so that `id` IS the dossierId. Then link evidence with dossier_evidence_link (every linked evidence must be COMPLETED; the API does not require its group to be sealed, but sealing it first (evidence_seal) is advised) and certify with dossier_certify. For one evidence group, dossier_group_certify does all three in one call.

embeddedEvidences.description: Optional, default false: the evidence files are not embedded. true embeds the evidence files linked to this dossier as attachments inside the dossier certificate PDF. GoCertius does not offer evidence embedding: on this deployment dossier_create always stores false, whatever is sent. Leave this field unset on GoCertius.

name: dossier_create
